output.body: Take sum_to(n), which equals 1+2+...+n and is defined as n + sum_to(n-1). Each call shrinks n by 1, so without a special rule it would go on to sum_to(-1), sum_to(-2), and so on forever. The fix is a line like 'if n == 0, the result is 0 and no further call is made', which gives the chain a place to end.
